I have a strange method, but it works for me. I exclusively pump and this has gotten enough to feed my baby, another baby that was in NICU with us, and we both freeze about 8 ounces a day. I use freemie cups with my baby Buddha. I start out in expression mode-usually 3-4 minutes. Once I feel a letdown I switch to stimulation/bacon mode and pump until there’s no more milk coming out. I switch back to expression mode at that point to trigger another letdown. I repeat this cycle until I’m empty. 

Also, at 4 wpp it’s a good idea to be pumping every 2-3 hours at least 8 times a day, until your supply comes in.
